notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup from edtech meetup talk. Early-stage SMB, lean engineering. Primary product interest: Hosted API (fast time-to-value).

CRM notes (shorthand):
- Wants a lightweight classroom copilot for teachers: summarization of student posts, suggested hints, generation of short formative quiz questions.
- Moderation: need a fast, deterministic profanity/policy filter pipeline with human-overrides. "If model flags, show reason + severity" — quoted from Head of Product.
- Budget: very price sensitive; current monthly target spend $200-800 on API. Looking for predictable per-class pricing or token caps.
- Latency/throughput: aim <=300ms median for short chat responses; burst traffic during class start (30-60 concurrent sessions).
- Model preference: open models okay; will consider Redwood-curated variants if cost is lower. Prefers simpler model for moderation, stronger for generative hints.
- Routing/fallbacks: wants graceful fallback to smaller model during quota exhaustion. Concerned about hallucination on grading prompts — asked about eval hooks.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) required for teacher/admin access; audit logs for student-data interactions; basic retention controls. No air-gapped needs.
- Technical skill: small infra team (1 full-time backend), prefers simple SDK integration examples.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We just need something that teachers can use day one — low friction."
- "Cost is the thing — we can't justify full Dedicated until we scale."
